name: agentic-acss-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for building accessible React components, CSS themes, and utility classes for fpkit/acss projects

plugins.name: acss-kit
plugins.description: Generate accessible React components, static HTML snippets, and CSS themes for fpkit/acss projects. Ships foundation.css (CSS reset, base typography, @layer cascade ordering) so new projects render correctly out of the box. Run /setup to bootstrap a new project (sass check, ui.tsx + foundation.css copy, starter theme). Then use /kit-list to browse the component catalogue, /kit-add for React components, /kit-add-html for static HTML versions (markup + SCSS + tiny vanilla JS for stateful components — works in any non-React project), /kit-create for natural-language creator mode ("primary pill button that says 'Add to cart'"), /kit-sync to bulk-install every component plus a starter theme in one command, /kit-update to safely re-copy unmodified files after a plugin upgrade, /theme-create, /theme-brand, /theme-update, and /theme-extract for theme generation and editing (image and Figma URLs supported), /color-scale to generate a 10-step OKLCH color scale from any hex, CSS named color, or theme role, and /style-tune for natural-language adjustments to theme roles or component tokens ("warmer button", "more elevated dialog"). Run /prompt-book for a copy-paste catalogue of example prompts. No @fpkit/acss npm package required.

plugins.name: style-agent
plugins.description: Write, extract, and organise CSS utilities and classes for any web project. Framework-agnostic — works with plain CSS, SCSS, Tailwind, or any utility-first workflow. Run /css-to-class to extract a list of utility classes from an HTML element or class string into a single named CSS class, with declarations resolved from your project's own CSS files.

plugins.name: acss-utilities
plugins.description: Tailwind-style atomic CSS utility classes for fpkit/acss projects (.bg-primary, .mt-4, .sm-hide). Hyphen-prefix responsive variants — no CSS escaping needed. Spacing utilities emit CSS logical properties so margin/padding follows the writing mode (LTR/RTL, vertical scripts). Pairs with acss-kit via a token-bridge. Run /utility-add to drop the bundle into your project, /utility-list to browse families and classes, /utility-bridge to regenerate the token bridge against your active acss-kit theme, and /utility-tune to adjust spacing baseline, breakpoints, or family enables via natural language.
